tcg.title: Mew ex FUR 135/103 M6a 30th Celebration Japanese Pokemon Card No.2
tcg.about: Mew ex 135/103 (full art ex, printed rarity UR) from the Japanese Pokemon Card Game expansion pack 30th Celebration (M6a), illustrated by YOSHIROTTEN. The seller describes it as new and unused and ships it in a sleeve; the photos show the front, the back and close-ups of the surface and corners, with no whitening, folds or dents visible. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: A new, unused Japanese Mew ex full art card from 30th Celebration.
tcg.perfect: Pokemon card collectors who want this card.
